description: Single-instance RedStone OEV auction, bid economics, and settlement-health dashboard. Native Grafana Dashboard Schema v2 delivery; Prometheus queries are scoped by namespace, kubernetes_pod, job, and instance. Requires vault-solver metrics commit d5f5385e or a descendant.

spec.title: Decision counts
spec.description: Every parsed auction contributes one bounded terminal decision.

spec.title: Hot-path latency
spec.description: Decision budget consumption before the auction deadline.

spec.title: Bid amount funnel
spec.description: Process-lifetime enqueued, won, and settled bid value; not revenue or realized profit.

spec.title: Count conversion
spec.description: Process-lifetime stage conversion; counters reset together on process restart.

spec.title: Feed connection history
spec.description: Feed continuity over the selected time range.

spec.title: Activity ages
spec.description: Comparable state, bid, win, and settlement freshness.

spec.title: Unresolved / failed lifecycle
spec.description: Unresolved wins, breaker failures, and failed settlements requiring attention.

spec.title: Auctions processed
spec.description: Process-lifetime counter for this solver process; resets on restart.

spec.title: Bids enqueued
spec.description: Process-lifetime counter for this solver process; resets on restart.

spec.title: Wins
spec.description: Process-lifetime counter for this solver process; resets on restart.

spec.title: Settled successfully
spec.description: Process-lifetime counter for this solver process; resets on restart.
